verdict.rationale: HMRC is a government tax authority offering online tax services and a REST API platform (Making Tax Digital), not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers. The 'agent' references in the evidence mean human tax agents acting for clients, not AI agents, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
